noah: Quick heads-up  planning to spend ~3 months in Dublin to help with family (2026-11-10 -> 2027-02-10). Staying on Redwood payroll. Questions: 1) do I change homebase? 2) WFH stipend ($125/mo)  paused/prorated? 3) can People Ops ship my laptop and spare monitor? 4) any Ireland-specific payroll/tax flags I should expect? @lauren (People Ops) @jamal (Payroll)
lauren (People Ops): Short answers: temporary stays under 180 days usually don't trigger homebase change but submit the Temporary Location Declaration in Workday so we can check local regs. Stipend is prorated; we pause months where you're physically away >50% business days. Shipping equipment is OK but needs asset tracking & customs docs. We'll loop Legal and Payroll for Ireland specifics.
noah: Filing form now. Company might book a short-term apartment for part of the stay. If we provide apartment + internet for a month, does that automatically cancel the stipend that month? Also any support for childcare costs?
jamal (Payroll): Ireland has PAYE rules; if you remain on Redwood payroll and are not a local hire, withholding continues. However, Revenue reporting and PRSI (social security) implications depend on whether work is considered performed in IE and on tie-breaker rules for social security. Company-paid lodging/internet can be a taxable benefit in Ireland; we need to get tax counsel advice. Stipend: prorated by calendar days at your primary home. Submit Workday temp location to flag payroll.
benefits-team: Health plan note: US medical plan likely has limited out-of-network coverage in Ireland. For 3 months, you remain enrolled but contact Benefits for local provider recommendations and for urgent care rules. If you need child care support, add a justification to the Workday declaration; People Ops can review for `TEMP_CARE_SUPPORT` one-time allowances.
travel-team: For equipment shipments: we require asset return commitment and temporary import paperwork. For monitor shipments, customs can be tricky; prefer local vendor rental if possible. Expense code for short apartment stays: `TRAVEL_SHORTSTAY_DUB` (we'll map to `TRAVEL_SHORTSTAY_DUB` regionally for EU), attach PO if People Ops pays vendor.
legal: Immigration/tax note: Ireland has a 183-day tax residence threshold; 3 months <183, so residency unlikely. But remote work performed in-country may trigger employer obligations. We need a brief scope of duties (meetings, hands-on pairing, client-facing?) in the Workday form to advise if a local employer registration or reporting is required. Also check if any double-tax treaty implications with US.
noah: Thanks 44d one other: my partner might accompany me and have occasional freelance work locally. Does that change anything?
lauren (People Ops): If partner works locally, that's separate but could affect household tax situations; not typically Redwood's payroll. Legal suggests partner gets local advice. For Redwood benefits and stipend: family accompanyers don't change employee stipend policy. For childcare support requests, include manager approval in Workday.
jamal (Payroll): If partner's work leads to local household payroll scrutiny, it could indirectly raise questions, but we treat employee cases individually. Please annotate the Workday entry with partner info so Legal can factor it into guidance.
noah: Form submitted with scope note and manager sign-off. Appreciate the swift replies :pray:
